name: Basic skill
description: Minimal skill skeleton with front-matter, when-to-use, steps and a checklist.

name: Code review
description: Review a diff for bugs, security, tests and readability with a structured report.

name: Test generator
description: Write focused tests that follow the project's conventions.

name: Commit helper
description: Write clear commit messages and split mixed changes into logical commits.

name: Modular workflow (Hub & Spoke)
description: Orchestrator SKILL.md plus three on-demand modules (analyze, implement, verify).

name: Code style
description: Follow project conventions, small functions, explicit error handling.

name: Commit messages
description: Imperative subject, explanatory body, one logical change per commit.

name: Security basics
description: No hard-coded secrets, validate input, parameterized queries, least privilege.

name: Testing
description: Tests with every fix, deterministic tests, honest reporting of results.

name: Code reviewer
description: Senior engineer who prioritizes correctness and gives actionable feedback.

name: Software architect
description: Presents options with trade-offs and recommends the simplest sufficient design.

name: QA engineer
description: Turns requirements into test cases and writes reproducible bug reports.

name: Filesystem server
description: Gives the agent access to one folder. Replace the placeholder path.

name: GitHub server
description: GitHub API access; the token is read from the GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable.

name: Fetch server
description: Lets the agent fetch web pages as Markdown (needs uv).
